messages:
maya: Heads up — ran into a user report where someone in the 'engineering' AD group was provisioned as `org_admin` after the SSO login. Noticed it across 7 users so far.

samir: Do we have an example SAML assertion?

maya: Pasting redacted assertion from Okta for one affected user:

maya: ```
<Attribute Name="memberOf">
  <AttributeValue>cn=Engineering,ou=Groups,dc=corp</AttributeValue>
  <AttributeValue>cn=Admin,ou=Groups,dc=corp</AttributeValue>  <!-- this is lowercase 'admin' in AD sometimes -->
</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="role">
  <AttributeValue>engineer</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
```

maya: The Okta->RBAC mapping rule is supposed to match exact group names, but looks like our JIT mapping normalizes case for memberOf and then runs a fuzzy contains that matches 'admin' substring.

okta-bot: SAML assertion received for user maya_test@redwood.com at 2024-11-14T15:34:12Z (authn request id: xyz-123)

jen: Ugh. We had a recent change in the mapping microservice (v1.4.0) where we switched to case-insensitive matching to accomodate MSAD varieants. That likely opened this path.

samir: Can you confirm whether the mapping pipeline does substring match after lowercasing? If so we should revert to exact-name matching immediately.

maya: Confirmed. Code snippet from mapping service: `if (normalizedAttr.includes(normalizedRule)) grant(role)` — so it's substring-based.

oli: @maya can you add the affected user ids to internal INCIDENT-957 so CS can notify impacted customers? Also, what's the blast radius — human users only? service accounts?

maya: So far human users only. No service accounts yet. Affected accounts: 7 external contractors + 2 internal engineers.

jen: Hotfix plan: 1) roll back to exact equality matching in mapping service (patch v1.4.1) 2) revoke `org_admin` for the 9 users via admin CLI 3) add strict unit tests for case + boundary matching 4) add detection rule to alert on sudden role escalations. Any objections?

samir: +1. Also need to check audit trail — interestingly the token audit shows login but our KMS key-usage logs don't show any privileged key access from those accounts yet. Good sign but we need a backfill to be safe.

maya: I ran a quick query: `SELECT user_id, granted_roles, created_at FROM rbac_events WHERE reason='jit_provision' AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'` — returns the 9 events. Exported to /tmp/jit_admins.csv.

jen: Can you run the admin revoke: `redwoodctl rbac revoke --user <id> --role org_admin --reason "post-sso-fix rollback"` and paste output? We'll script it for all 9.

maya: Running now...

maya: ```
> redwoodctl rbac revoke --user u-123 --role org_admin --reason "post-sso-fix rollback"
Success: user u-123 removed from org_admin (audit id a-789)
```

oli: I'll open a CS message & incident update: "We've mitigated an SSO role-mapping issue that briefly granted elevated roles to a small set of users. No privileged key usage detected; users have been demoted. We'll follow up with audit and postmortem." :white_check_mark:

samir: Forensics checklist: 1) backfill KMS and RBAC access logs for the last 7 days 2) check for any sessions with elevated tokens 3) rotate any short-lived credentials issued while elevated 4) create postmortem with timeline and PR id for the mapping change.

jen: I'll push the mapping patch now, tagging it hotfix/1889001234-casefold-rollback and open PR referencing INCIDENT-957.

okta-bot: Deploy started for service mapping-service v1.4.1 by jen (deploy id d-445).

maya: After deploy, can someone run a synthetic login for a few affected users to verify we don't re-elevate? 

jen: Deploy complete. Running synthetic checks...

jen: Synthetic results: 9/9 logins now produce role=engineer and no org_admin grant. Sample assertion now trimmed to exact group matching.

samir: Great. Next actions: add a regression test gating that prevents substring-based matching in prod, and alert rule that fires if >3 JIT org_admin grants in 24h.

maya: I'll also add an audit query and schedule a KMS log backfill job. Putting a note in the incident doc.

oli: Notifying impacted customers and updating CS thread. Thanks everyone. :pray:

maya: Will follow up with postmortem and remediation tasks (config change, test, alert, docs)
